title: ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-bit weight--activation quantization reduces the memory and computation needed to deploy large language models, but activation rounding can still degrade accuracy after calibration. Reconstruction from rounded inputs cannot distinguish activations within the same quantization bin. We propose ResCom, a low-rank correction that uses the activation rounding residual to compensate for the resulting layer-output error. An output-aware calibration procedure selects residual directions by their contribution to output reconstruction and computes the correction in closed form, without gradient training or updates to the calibrated weights. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weights and activations, rank-32 attention corrections reduce WikiText-2 perplexity from 7.708 to 7.147, improve MMLU by 2.89 percentage points, and raise five-shot GSM8K accuracy from 23.96 to 36.16 percent. translated_title: ResCom：面向大语言模型量化的激活残差补偿
translated_abstract: 低比特权重-激活量化可以降低部署大语言模型所需的内存和计算量，但即使经过校准，激活舍入仍可能导致精度下降。基于舍入后输入的重建无法区分同一量化区间内的激活值。我们提出ResCom，一种低秩校正方法，利用激活舍入残差来补偿由此产生的层输出误差。该方法的输出感知校准流程根据残差方向对输出重建的贡献来选择这些方向，并以闭式形式计算校正，无需梯度训练，也无需更新已校准的权重。在采用4比特权重和激活的Llama-3-8B上，秩为32的注意力校正将WikiText-2困惑度从7.708降至7.147，MMLU提升2.89个百分点，五样本GSM8K准确率从23.96%提升至36.16%。对参数规模从1B到70B的模型以及在留出的C4测试集上的评估（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: ResCom提出一种低秩激活残差补偿方法，通过输出感知校准以闭式形式利用激活舍入残差校正层输出误差，无需梯度训练即可显著提升大语言模型4比特权重-激活量化的精度。
